reports.title: Sunrun Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: For the full-year 2026, Aggregate Subscriber Value is now expected to be approximately $4.6 billion, compared to the company’s prior guidance of $4.6 billion to $4.9 billion.

Cash Generation1,2 is now expected to be approximately $200 million for the full-year 2026, excluding investments related to equipment safe harboring, compared to the company’s prior guidance of $200 million to $375 million.
